view.description: Choices a new view starts with; written into the view file at creation. Options in the view change them per view.

traverse.description: command: Upstream callers starts with callers, Calls downstream with calls; both: every new view starts with callers and calls of its seed.

family.description: CSS font-family; a monospace font keeps glyphs on the grid.

lineHeight.description: Row height as a multiple of the font size.

arrow.description: Order callers: `└─>` and `<─┘` when true, `└──` and `──┘` when false. Order callees never draws arrowheads.

cross.description: Glyph where a lane crosses a horizontal of another net without joining.

lead.description: Sigmoid curves: cells of straight line out of the caller and into the callee.

tension.description: Sigmoid curves: reach of the control points, 0 sharp, 1 wide.

strip.description: Module prefixes removed from labels, e.g. "foo.".

colors.description: CSS colors; keys fg, bg, edge, highlight, seed, between, frame, namespace, external, selected.

modules.description: Also box each module or file.

root.description: Draw the outermost box when every node lies in it.

fill.description: Background color per box, hue from the box name.

line.description: Frame line: dashed (default) and dotted frames read apart from solid call lines.
